pilierStrategique: Strategic pillar of the national economy, Tunisian agriculture faces increasing pressure: water scarcity, climate instability, data fragmentation and low digitization of practices. To remain performant and resilient, farms need smarter tools to better observe, better anticipate and better decide.
problematiqueEauShort: Water stress and lack of precise irrigation control permanently weaken farm performance.
problematiqueEauContent: In Tunisia, water scarcity requires much finer resource management. However, the absence of soil sensors, remote monitoring and early detection of irrigation anomalies promotes waste, undetected failures and irrigation decisions poorly adapted to the real needs of crops.
problematiqueSurveillanceShort: Continuous monitoring of plots remains difficult, expensive and often insufficient to act at the right time.
problematiqueSurveillanceContent: Whether for large areas or scattered farms, monitoring means remain often manual, punctual and unreactive. Localized anomalies, first signs of stress or irrigation defects are therefore detected late, which reduces the effectiveness of interventions and increases potential losses.
problematiqueClimatiqueShort: Drought, extreme heat and local microclimates make agricultural decisions more complex and riskier.
problematiqueClimatiqueContent: General weather forecasts often remain too broad to reflect local realities. In a country marked by strong climatic diversity, this limit reduces farmers' ability to correctly anticipate irrigation, treatments, harvests and all decisions sensitive to field conditions.
problematiqueDonneesShort: Agricultural data exists, but remains fragmented between several tools, files and isolated observations.
problematiqueDonneesContent: Soil analyses, weather, manual observations, Excel spreadsheets and various applications do not communicate with each other. This fragmentation prevents a global view of the farm, limits useful correlations between data and greatly reduces their impact on the quality of agronomic and operational decisions.
problematiqueDecisionsTitle: Decisions still little driven by data
problematiqueDecisionsShort: Fertilization, irrigation, risk prevention and field interventions still too often rely on intuition.
problematiqueDecisionsContent: The lack of continuous, localized and directly exploitable data prevents transforming information into simple and actionable recommendations. Farms thus struggle to prioritize the right actions, intervene with precision and optimize their resources in an increasingly demanding economic context.
problematiqueDurabiliteShort: Sustainable agricultural efforts remain little recognized, little tracked and insufficiently valued economically.
problematiqueDurabiliteContent: Reduction of inputs, better water management, agroecological practices or contribution to carbon sequestration remain difficult to measure and poorly remunerated. To this are added often long and opaque marketing circuits, which limit producers' margins and slow down sustainable investment.

agricultureDurableAgroSolDesc: AgroSol provides a finer reading of critical soil parameters to help adjust inputs, reduce dosage drift, and preserve productive soil quality.

agricultureDurableNoyaSatDesc: NoyaSat delivers a visual and spatial reading of the field, identifies stressed zones and guides more targeted checks or interventions.
agricultureDurableEsgSubtitle: Useful indicators before they become reports
agricultureDurableEsgEnvDesc: Reduce waste, allocate resources better and document environmental gains over time.
agricultureDurableEsgSocialDesc: Equip field teams and farmers with tools that are clearer, faster and more useful for decision-making.
agricultureDurableEsgGovernanceDesc: Structure data, historize decisions and improve the quality of technical and management reports.
agricultureDurablePerformanceTitle: Sustainable performance is tracked across three horizons
agricultureDurablePerformanceAgronomyDes: Soil, crop, stress, consistency of performance
agricultureDurableSustainabilityValue: Sustainability has value when it improves decision quality, reduces avoidable losses, and makes performance more resilient over time. That's the link between impact and control that AgroNoya aims to materialize.
agricultureDurableFinalCtaSubtitle: it starts with building a better decision system
agricultureDurableQuote: “AgroNoya positions agricultural data as a lever for resilience, efficiency and performance. Our goal is to make every hectare more readable, every decision more defensible, and every season more manageable.”
agricultureDurableAudienceDesc: A page designed to speak to farmers as well as partners, decision-makers and actors driving transformation in the agricultural sector.
agronoyaAccompagne: AgroNoya supports agricultural farms with AI solutions, field observation, satellite imagery and intelligent management to improve decisions, optimize resources and strengthen sustainable performance.
footerAbout: AgriTech solutions designed to help agricultural stakeholders better observe, anticipate and make decisions in the field.
noyaGptHeroDesc: Smart chatbot that understands your farm data and provides actionable recommendations.
noyaGptKeyFactsDesc: The AI assistant that understands your agriculture and challenges.
noyaGptTechDesc: Intelligent assistant connected to your agricultural data.
noyaGptMainFeaturesTitle: Personalized AI Assistant for Your Farm
noyaGptMainFeaturesDesc: Noya GPT accesses your field data, weather history and practices to provide ultra-personalized advice. Ask in natural language and get expert answers instantly.
noyaGptChatGreeting: Hello! How can I help with your crops today?
noyaGptChatUserExample: My tomatoes have brown spots on the leaves
noyaGptChatResponse: Based on your symptoms, it is likely late blight. I recommend a copper-based treatment. Shall I check weather conditions for optimal timing?
noyaGptUseCaseDiagnosisDesc: Instant photo-based identification with treatment recommendations
noyaGptUseCaseAdviceDesc: Recommendations based on your field data and history
noyaGptUseCaseTrainingDesc: Interactive learning of best agricultural practices
noyaGptCtaDesc: Don’t face farming challenges alone. Noya GPT supports you with expert tips anytime.
